title: Peer Instructor for AFE 100
description: The purpose of this course is to develop the leadership skills of Peer Instructors while enhancing the learning and success of students enrolled in AFE 100. Peer Instructors will support enrolled students as they adapt to the academic expectations of the AFE 100 curriculum and will assist students in their transition to the University of Kentucky.
prerequisites: Completion of AFE 100 Issues in Agriculture, Food and Environment with a ‘B’ or higher and consent of instructor
